title: Mixture of Agents ordinary fallback and interruption

install.basis: real candidate source checkout in its repository virtual environment

terminal.program: Talaria via POSIX PTY on macOS

expected.text: Distinguish ordinary absence of rich events from zero work; supported cancellation leaves an honest terminal summary and no permanently running progress.

actual:
Four frames visually reviewed. Real ordinary completion and real interruption are both present. No code4014 is substituted for an absent reply; the actual interrupt reply is retained.
Clause 1: pass: The real ordinary Ready turn completes before the MoA action. Its full sourceSeq1–47 interval has no moa event type; the derived log keeps all event types without an event filter. Inspector says no progress events observed, not zero work. (https://github.com/infiquetra/talaria/issues/148)
Clause 2: pass: A supported Ctrl+S interrupts the real MoA run after two of five references. The gateway answers session.interrupt with interrupted; message.complete at sourceSeq86 also reports interrupted. Both terminal frames show the durable interrupted2/5 summary and no working progress indicator. (https://github.com/infiquetra/talaria/issues/148)
Clause 3: pass: Late reference/phase events remain in the complete wire record; they do not replace the interrupted summary with a fabricated success. The session ends after the terminal witness; an unrelated model-restore step is not attempted.
